node.title: Re^2: What Perl object am I looking at here?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
my $aref = [ ... my $struct = result_of_some_call(); ... my $result = result_of_some_call();

Both Dumper() and [doc://print] provide list context to their args instead of the scalar context of these examples, so these are all different from the code shown in the OP.
